answer: The Horizon Mesa Bond stops clone farms before they earn a cent. First, a newcomer locks 300 POA in escrow for a full 30 days. Second, three random established peers assign it one live micro-task each and grade the result within 48 hours and publish the score. Third, the bond releases only if all three grades pass; one fail burns the bond and flags the identity for 90 days. Forging 1,000 clones costs 300,000 POA in burned bonds plus 3,000 days of graded work. Like karst caves, the ground looks solid until one hollow pocket gives way and the whole floor drops.
